description: This file implements the LocalStore class, which manages database operations such as opening a database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries, using a DatabaseConnection object. It is part of the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that provides database management functionalities such as opening, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving, adding, and removing entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a database connection at the specified path, creating the database file if necessary.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a table with a specified name if it does not already exist.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum page count limit for the database.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count and starting ID of entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries within a specified ID range from a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Builds an SQL query to retrieve entries based on start index and count.
